value.rationale: The primary literature identifies the section-width minimax as a longstanding problem. The theorem completely resolves a canonical non-ellipsoidal affine class in dimension three, determines both extrema and all equality directions, and shows that aspect ratio and shear are irrelevant because the full normalized profile is affinely reparameterized. This provides a reusable benchmark for both the minimax and maximin sides rather than a routine single-direction computation.
